title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 7th Proof The Affirmation Of The Family And Companions

questions.question: Which two groups are mentioned in the passage as giving a united judgment about the Prophet?
questions.answer: His family and his companions.

questions.question: How are these people described in terms of character and religious standing?
questions.answer: They are described as deeply insightful, knowledgeable, spiritually accomplished, respected, well-known, very pious, and sharp in understanding.

questions.question: After whom are they presented as the finest people?
questions.answer: After the prophets.

questions.question: What did they carefully examine about the Prophet?
questions.answer: They closely checked his conditions, thoughts, and behavior, both private and public.

questions.question: How seriously did they carry out this examination?
questions.answer: They did it with great care, seriousness, and precision.

questions.question: What conclusion did they all reach?
questions.answer: They agreed that he was the most truthful, noble, and trustworthy person in the world.

questions.question: What does their complete agreement help prove?
questions.answer: It supports the truth of his reality and honesty.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show how clear this proof is?
questions.answer: It is compared to the clearness of daylight proving the sun.

questions.question: What is the main claim made about the Prophet in this passage?
questions.answer: That the people closest to him confirmed that he was completely truthful and upright.

questions.question: Which people are said to have made this judgment?
questions.answer: His family and companions.

questions.question: Did they look only at what was seen in public, or more than that?
questions.answer: They looked at both his open life and what was hidden.

questions.question: What qualities of these people make their testimony stronger?
questions.answer: Their insight, knowledge, spiritual excellence, piety, and sharp understanding.

questions.question: What was the result of their study of him?
questions.answer: They all agreed on his honesty, truthfulness, and high rank.

questions.question: What can we infer from the fact that they were unanimous?
questions.answer: Their conclusion was firm and not weakened by serious disagreement among them.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the strength of their belief after reaching this conclusion?
questions.answer: It describes it as steady and not shaken.

questions.question: What image is used to show that their testimony is very clear?
questions.answer: The image of bright daylight showing the reality of the sun.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kinds of abilities did the Prophet’s family and companions have?
questions.answer: They had deep understanding, learning, and spiritual maturity.

questions.question: How does the passage rank them among people in general?
questions.answer: It places them among the greatest people after the prophets.

questions.question: What parts of the Prophet’s life did they inspect?
questions.answer: They examined his inner and outer states.

questions.question: Why is it important that they looked at both hidden and open matters?
questions.answer: Because it shows they did not judge him from appearances alone.

questions.question: What words in the passage show that their investigation was not casual?
questions.answer: It says they examined him with full attention, seriousness, and exactness.

questions.question: What three qualities did they finally affirm about him?
questions.answer: That he was the most truthful, the most elevated, and the most honest.

questions.question: What is the effect of comparing their proof to daylight and the sun?
questions.answer: It shows that their testimony is presented as obvious and strong.

questions.question: Who are the witnesses in this passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and companions.

questions.question: What makes these witnesses especially credible?
questions.answer: Their knowledge, insight, spiritual strength, piety, and respected position.

questions.question: What did they do before reaching their decision?
questions.answer: They carefully investigated every side of the Prophet’s life.

questions.question: What does the mention of both concealed and visible matters add to the meaning?
questions.answer: It shows their examination covered what people usually see and what is harder to know.

questions.question: What final shared judgment did they make about him?
questions.answer: They judged him to be supremely truthful, noble, and trustworthy.

questions.question: Is their testimony described as weak, doubtful, or firm?
questions.answer: It is described as firm.

questions.question: What does their firm belief become in the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: It becomes a strong proof for the truth of who he was.

questions.question: Why is the word “unanimous” important in this passage?
questions.answer: It shows they were united and not divided in their conclusion.

questions.question: Which relationship to the Prophet is emphasized in the passage: distant followers or close people around him?
questions.answer: Close people around him.

questions.question: What qualities are given for these close people?
questions.answer: They had insight, knowledge, spiritual achievement, piety, honor, and sharp perception.

questions.question: What action did they take concerning the Prophet?
questions.answer: They examined and checked his life very carefully.

questions.question: What areas did they include in that examination?
questions.answer: They included his inner and outer states, thoughts, and conditions.

questions.question: What conclusion did they all come to together?
questions.answer: That he was the truest, most honorable, and most honest human being.

questions.question: How does the passage show that this was not a temporary opinion?
questions.answer: It says their affirmation and belief were firm and unshakable.

questions.question: What kind of proof does their agreement become?
questions.answer: A very clear proof of his truth and authenticity.

questions.question: What example from nature is used to explain that clarity?
questions.answer: The way daylight makes the sun evident.

questions.question: In the passage, what was the attitude of the Prophet’s family and companions when examining him?
questions.answer: They were attentive, serious, and exact.

questions.question: What does this attitude tell us about the quality of their judgment?
questions.answer: It tells us their judgment was careful and reliable.

questions.question: What personal strengths did these examiners have?
questions.answer: They had wisdom, learning, spiritual excellence, piety, and strong insight.

questions.question: How highly does the passage speak of them compared with the rest of humanity?
questions.answer: It says they are among the best and most honored people after the prophets.

questions.question: What exactly did they study about the Prophet?
questions.answer: They studied all his states, ideas, and conditions, whether seen openly or not.

questions.question: What was their united conclusion about his moral character?
questions.answer: That he was perfectly honest and truthful, with the highest character.

questions.question: How does the passage move from observation to proof?
questions.answer: It says their careful investigation led to a united conviction, and that conviction serves as evidence.

questions.question: Summarize the passage in one clear sentence.
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and companions, who were highly respected and spiritually strong, closely examined him and all agreed that his truthfulness was beyond doubt.
